room_rent.note: Room rent up to limit/category per Schedule; proportionate deduction if higher. VERIFY category

copayment.note: Base/national plan no co-pay. Variants: Value Plan = 30% if hospitalised out-of-network; Geo Plan = 20% if hospitalised in Zone A; plus 20% age-linked co-pay where applicable. VERIFY age-linked threshold

sub_limits.note: Procedure sub-limits exist (e.g. robotic surgery capped by SI band). VERIFY full list

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl 18); no maternity benefit found. VERIFY

cumulative_bonus.note: 5X Supercharge Bonus: 50%/yr up to 500%, not reduced on claim

restoration.note: Restore Benefit 100% once/yr inbuilt; Restore Infinity (optional) gives unlimited reinstatements after Restore Benefit exhausted

ambulance.note: Road ambulance per Schedule; Emergency Air Ambulance is optional (C2). VERIFY road limit

modern_treatments.note: Robotic/modern treatments covered with per-procedure sub-limits by SI band

notable_exclusions.display: Plan-variant co-pays (Value=out-of-network, Geo=Zone A); modern-treatment sub-limits; maternity excluded

optional_riders.display: Restore Infinity (unlimited restore), Emergency Air Ambulance, Consumables Benefit
